subject.name: Mathematics
subject.textbook: NCERT Mathematics X (Standard 041 / Basic 241 – same syllabus)
subject.examPattern: CBSE Board exam, 3 h, 80 theory + 20 internal assessment; 'no change in question paper design for 2026-27'. Two board exams: Phase 1 (Feb, mandatory) + Phase 2 (May, optional improvement in up to 3 subjects). Paper (SQP 2026-27): 38 questions – A 20×1 (18 MCQ + 2 A-R), B 5×2, C 6×3, D 4×5, E 3 case-study×4. Typology Standard 54/24/22%, Basic 75/15/10%. No calculators.
